messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Apply a full-body orbit camera shot that starts in front of the subject and moves through a side view toward the rear over a 120-degree arc. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please switch the camera setup to a full-body orbit shot that starts in front and moves through a side view toward the rear over a 120-degree arc. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands facing forward, then raises her arms overhead and begins to spin and dance in a circle on the road.","camera":"A low-angle, wide shot that orbits around the character as she moves, keeping her centered in the frame.","clothing":"A bright pink long-sleeved top with a darker pink collar, a light pink pleated mini skirt, and black ankle boots.","hair_color":"Bright blonde.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair styled in two high buns on top of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build and tanned skin.","scene":"An outdoor paved road or highway under a concrete overpass, with guardrails, orange traffic cones, and trees with yellow leaves in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output begins with a frontal full-body view matching the reference framing, then the camera orbits around the character from the front through side views to a rear view by the end of the clip. The character remains in the same pink outfit and performs the same standing, arm-raising, and spinning dance sequence in the same road/overpass scene.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a full-body orbit starting in front of the character, moving through a side view toward the rear over a 120-degree arc, while preserving her identity, appearance, clothing, action, scene, and timing.
uncertain: The exact orbit angle is not measurable from the frames, so whether it is precisely 120 degrees is uncertain.
unexpected_changes: Background perspective and visible scene elements change more than a pure camera orbit would imply, with some background geometry appearing rearranged or regenerated during the orbit.
